name: manga-localizer
description: Local-first manga OCR, translation, review, inpainting, and typesetting workbench

scripts.setup: uv sync --project backend --group dev && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:ai: uv sync --project backend --group dev --extra ai && npm run setup:models
scripts.setup:test: npm run setup && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run check:launcher && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend scripts/audit_release.py scripts/bootstrap_clean_plate_run.py scripts/bootstrap_detection_annotations.py scripts/compare_inpaint.py scripts/compare_upscale.py scripts/evaluate_detection_ocr.py scripts/evaluate_real_data.py scripts/prepare_clean_plate_review.py scripts/setup_optional_models.py && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend scripts/audit_release.py scripts/bootstrap_clean_plate_run.py scripts/bootstrap_detection_annotations.py scripts/compare_inpaint.py scripts/compare_upscale.py scripts/evaluate_detection_ocr.py scripts/evaluate_real_data.py scripts/prepare_clean_plate_review.py scripts/setup_optional_models.py && uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run && npm --prefix frontend run build
